name: Four Seasons Resort Sharm El Sheikh
positioning: Hillside resort overlooking the Red Sea on the Sinai Peninsula, with private beachfront and its own dive shop
best_for: Travelers who want diving and snorkelling from a resort with its own dive shop

facts.text: The resort has 289 rooms in total.
The resort is perched on a hill overlooking the Red Sea on the Sinai Peninsula.
The resort is 10 minutes from Sharm El Sheikh International Airport.
The resort has a kilometre of private beachfront.
The resort's gardens have more than 3,000 palm trees.
Two funiculars transport guests down from peak to beach.
The resort is home to nine restaurants and three lounges.
Bullona is a Mediterranean seafood restaurant.
The resort has a 24-hour fitness centre.

highlights.text: The resort is home to two jetties and its own dive shop.
Kids For All Seasons is a complimentary program for kids ages 4 to 12.
The Premier Sea-View Room offers the resort's very best view of the Red Sea.
The Palace is a stand-alone three-bedroom residence, described as the resort's largest, most lavish suite.
The spa has two outdoor cabanas facing the Red Sea.

considerations.text: External taxis are not permitted to enter the resort gate.
The Pyramids of Giza are approximately 500 kilometres from Sharm El Sheikh.
WhataHotel notes the remote desert location requires planned transportation for exploring beyond the resort.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
